item.description: COLLEGE BASEBALL Christopher Newport (5-1) moved into the rankings of the D3baseball.com and the National Collegiate Baseball Writers Association at No. 22 before its home game at 2 p.m. Wednesday against Bridgewater (7-0). item.description: The Landstown star responds after seeing a social media post about him before the game.

item.title: Man sentenced to 40 years in fatal Virginia Beach robbery
item.description: Javon Pollard, of Portsmouth, was sentenced to 40 years in prison for fatally shooting a 20-year-old after attempting to rob him of Percocet pills and crashing into another car, resulting in injuries to the driver, while attempting to flee.

item.description: He's making the case to Americans who are increasingly uneasy about his priorities.

item.title: Virginia Beach attorney selected as GOP nominee for Del. Barry Knight’s seat
item.description: Virginia Beach Deputy Commonwealth's Attorney Andrew Rice beat five other candidates to become the Republican nominee in a special election to fill Del. Barry Knight's House of Delegates seat.

item.title: ODU falls on the road to Marshall, VWU men win ODAC opener
item.description: Wyatt Fricks scored 28 points as the Herd pulled into a three-way tie for first place in the Sun Belt Conference standings.

item.title: David Teel: Block party ignites No. 11 UVA’s rout of NC State
item.description: Suffocating defense for a half. Smoldering offense for the other half. As victory formulas go, that’s darn near infallible, as No. 11 Virginia displayed Tuesday night in a 90-61 rout of NC State.
